    rounds = int(inputs.get('rounds', inputs.get('times', inputs.get('iterations'))))
    a = int(inputs.get('left1', inputs.get('a', inputs.get('shift1'))))
    b = int(inputs.get('right', inputs.get('b', inputs.get('shift2'))))
    c = int(inputs.get('left2', inputs.get('c', inputs.get('shift3'))))
    mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
    for _ in range(rounds):
        x ^= (x << a) & mask
        x &= mask
        x ^= x >> b
        x &= mask
        x ^= (x << c) & mask
        x &= mask
    return float(x)

def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    residues = inputs.get('residues', inputs.get('remainders', inputs.get('a')))
    moduli = inputs.get('moduli', inputs.get('mods', inputs.get('m')))
    residues = [int(v) for v in residues]
    moduli = [int(v) for v in moduli]
    x, modulus = 0, 1
    for residue, mod in zip(residues, moduli):
        t = ((residue - x) * pow(modulus, -1, mod)) % mod
        x += modulus * t
        modulus *= mod
        x %= modulus
    return float(x)
